# Raster

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `docs` theme, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dark DAM marketing: black page, zinc canvas, Raster Red #ff2f66 actions at 5.25px radius, a cinema-lens gradient clipped to the hero line, Raster Neue wordmark against a 14px system sans, and a separate light docs surface.

Captured 2026-11-19, public signed out. Sign-in was opened and measured (Google and an email-link field). The email was not submitted. Google was not used. No card, phone, or checkout.. Themes: dark, docs.

A token set for Raster's public signed-out surfaces, for building a dark marketing page in the style of the real thing. It was read from **raster.app** on **2026-11-19**, signed out. Desktop captures are 1440 x 900 at 1x. The phone pass measured innerWidth 390 at 2x. Captured: `/`, `/product`, `/pricing`, `/blog`, `/design`, `/changelog`, and `/docs`.

Raster is a digital asset manager. The marketing site paints one dark theme: a black page, a zinc canvas (`#27272a`), and Raster Red (`#ff2f66`) on the actions. The hero's first line clips a cinema-lens gradient to the text. The wordmark is Raster Neue. Body and buttons are the system sans at a 14px root. Docs at `/docs` is a separate light surface (`html.light`, page `#f5f5f5`). **Boundary:** `/sign-in` offers Continue with Google and an email-link field. Both were measured. The email was not submitted. Google was not used. No card, phone, or checkout was entered. The signed-in library was not reached.

## Typography

15 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: -apple-system, Raster Neue, ui-sans-serif.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Raster Neue is the product face (wordmark, nav, pricing titles, docs headings). It ships as a woff2 from the site. The licence was not published on the pages that were read, so the file is not in this package. Body, buttons, and fields compute to the system sans (`-apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Noto Sans, Arial`). Docs body computes to `ui-sans-serif`. The mono stack is declared (`ui-monospace`) and was not used on the pages that were measured.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The focus ring on Get started is the browser default (`rgb(153, 200, 255) auto 1px`), not a product token. Hover on that button did not change the computed background. Disabled is opacity 0.5 on the same red. The oklab white tints (8%, 10%, 15%, 18%) are computed as written; they are not rounded to hex. The hero gradient is a background-clip on the first line, so a screenshot of that line is not a flat colour. Phone shots are 780 x 1688 because devicePixelRatio was 2. Docs light is a different product surface, not a light mode of the marketing page.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do put Raster Red on the action.** `#ff2f66` is Start for free, Get started, and Contact Sales. See [home-dark-default](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
2. **Do clip the cinema gradient to one line.** The first hero line is the only gradient text. The lines under it are near-white. See [hero-heading](components/crops/hero-heading-default.png).
3. **Do keep the page black and the canvas zinc.** Body is `#000`. The root is `#27272a`. See [home-dark-default](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
4. **Do use 5.25px on controls.** Buttons, fields, and the sign-in email share that radius. Tags are pills. See [button-primary](components/crops/button-primary-default.png).
5. **Do keep Raster Neue on the wordmark.** Nav labels and plan titles use it. Body and buttons use the system sans. See [navbar](components/crops/navbar-default.png).
6. **Don't treat docs as a light marketing theme.** `/docs` is its own light product surface. See [docs-light-default](screenshots/docs-light-default.png).
7. **Don't invent a hover colour.** The primary button's computed background did not change on hover. Disabled is the same red at 0.5 opacity. See [button-primary-disabled](components/crops/button-primary-disabled.png).
8. **Don't follow sign-in into the library.** The email field and the Google button were measured and not used. See [components.md](components.md).
